environment: Codex in-app browser, real browser DOM and rendered application iframe
subsequentVerification: After this six-scene run, long independent control groups (NTC24/PC23/NoRT13 with ordinary technical replicate 3) were added and verified in the dedicated core regression suite across 96/384 and project/plate scopes. That extension is not represented as an additional browser scenario here.
method: Run button executes browser-acceptance.js against visible form controls, real DOM events, SVG wells, guarded navigator, Tablet and JSON file input. No jsdom or internal QPCRTest state. Results read from the rendered page after execution.

scenarios.name: 96孔标准四样品、四assay、三重复
scenarios.observed: 48个反应，一板；A/H内参正确，标准样品列组宽3。

scenarios.name: 96孔六样品紧凑填充
scenarios.observed: 54个反应留在一板，剩余2样品紧凑填充，导航采用真实孔位。

scenarios.name: 384孔十八样品及Tablet批次
scenarios.observed: 162个反应，一块384板；Q1–Q4可见，Tablet精确匹配当前批次，暂停熄灭。

scenarios.name: 独立量程、最后一批与死体积
scenarios.observed: 引物0.4µL/孔，2µL上限：5+5+2孔，2+2+0.8µL；每来源死体积只加一次。

scenarios.name: QC显式启用和已有对照恢复
scenarios.observed: 默认QC关闭；NTC跟随3重复产生9孔，PC独立控制，保存恢复保留两种对照。

scenarios.name: 修改失效、重新生成与JSON实际孔位恢复
scenarios.observed: Sample/Target顺序、重复数、Reserved修改后旧清单失效；JSON实际孔位和当前批次一致。

limitations: JSON round trip captures the Save button Blob and supplies a real File to the browser file input; the operating system file picker and physical download location were not tested.
Touch gestures, iPhone/iPad Safari installation, fullscreen permission, wake lock, physical plate alignment and actual dispensing were not tested on hardware.
A4 portrait/landscape and print content were checked by DOM integration tests. System print dialogs, PDF pagination and a physical printer were not verified.
